About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services in strategy and consulting, interactive, technology, and operations, powered by exceptional digital capabilities across all of these areas. With deep industry expertise, a culture of innovation, and a commitment to delivering value, we help organizations navigate complexity and transform with confidence.
We believe in inclusion, diversity, and supporting the whole person. Our core values include Stewardship, Best People, Client Value Creation, One Global Network, Respect for the Individual, and Integrity. "Across the globe, one thing is universally true of the people of Accenture: We care deeply about what we do and the impact we have with our clients and with the communities in which we work and live. It is personal to all of us."
Julie Sweet, Accenture CEO
Introduction
At Accenture Security, we are seeking an accomplished CrowdStrike Security Architect to strengthen our Cyber Defense and Resilience practice. We are looking for a recognized cybersecurity expert with deep experience in security operations transformation, CrowdStrike Falcon platform implementations, and executive-level client engagement.
The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise across endpoint security, NG-SIEM, identity protection, cloud security, exposure management, and AI-driven security capabilities with the ability to guide strategic cybersecurity initiatives. This role requires a trusted advisor who can bridge business and technical priorities, helping clients modernize their security posture, consolidate technologies, and achieve measurable cyber resilience outcomes.
Working at the intersection of Accenture's consulting excellence and CrowdStrike's technology leadership, you will help some of the world's largest organizations accelerate their security transformation journeys while shaping innovative offerings for the market.
What's in It for You
Partner with leading organizations to modernize and transform cybersecurity operations.
Collaborate with Accenture's CrowdStrike Business Group and global security specialists.
Influence strategic security decisions and large-scale cyber transformation programs.
Shape innovative cybersecurity offerings and contribute to market-leading solutions.
Access continuous learning, certifications, and the latest security technologies.
Key Responsibilities
Lead executive-level discovery sessions with CISOs, SOC leaders, and security architects to assess security strategies and identify transformation opportunities.
Design and present CrowdStrike Falcon solution architectures, demonstrations, and business value assessments aligned to client objectives.
Serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout pre-sales engagements and cybersecurity modernization initiatives.
Guide enterprise clients through security operations transformation, platform consolidation, and cyber resilience programs.
Contribute to the growth of Accenture's CrowdStrike offerings through thought leadership, innovation, and opportunity development.
Necessary Knowledge / Skills
Deep expertise in the CrowdStrike Falcon platform, including NG-SIEM, Exposure Management (CTEM), Identity Protection, Cloud Security, and AI-driven capabilities.
Strong understanding of security operations, threat detection, incident response, cyber threat intelligence, and enterprise cyber defense strategies.
Proven ability to engage senior stakeholders and translate business requirements into scalable security architectures and solutions.
Broad knowledge of enterprise security ecosystems, including cloud platforms, identity infrastructure, hybrid environments, and vulnerability management technologies.
Excellent communication, consulting, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts in business terms.
Preferred Qualifications
CrowdStrike certifications such as CCFA, CCSE, or CrowdStrike Champions credentials.
Experience delivering CrowdStrike NG-SIEM implementations, migrations, parser development, CQL, or LogScale administration.
Background in managed security services, MSSP/MDR environments, or large-scale security operations programs.
Knowledge of CTEM methodologies, attack surface management, exposure reduction, and leading vulnerability management platforms.
Familiarity with security frameworks and threat intelligence practices, including NIST CSF, ISO 27001, DORA, MITRE ATT&CK, and adversary tracking.
